name: @metorial/productboard
description: Read current Productboard entity records, discover workspace entity types and field configurations, and inspect the connected OAuth user. Entity reads use API v2; OAuth identity requires an OAuth connection. Retained legacy API v1 tools are unavailable after the announced July 8, 2026 sunset. See https://developer.productboard.com/v1.0.0/changelog/2026-04-09.
skills: discover available entity types and field configurations
read and filter current entity records
inspect the connected OAuth user and workspace
